Led a team of 8 engineers across Payments and Data Platform
Owned the backend hiring loop and ran interview debriefs
Primary on-call for payments and resolved a sev1 connection-pool exhaustion in 38 minutes
Reduced incident volume by 90% through observability work
Implemented GDPR erasure for payout records in coordination with legal
Mentored junior engineers on the Payments team
Expert-level production experience with Kafka and event streaming
Advanced PostgreSQL performance tuning at scale
